title: Anonymised Renewal Complaint Themes - November 2025
content:
## Complaint email themes

Synthetic and anonymised aggregate summary.
Comments focus mainly on claims-handling speed and communication clarity.
Price is mentioned by a small minority and there is no concentrated affordability or fairness pattern.

title: Renewal Survey Comments - December 2025
content:
## Survey comments

Synthetic and anonymised aggregate comments report satisfaction with claims support and policy communications.
Price-related comments remain a small minority with no recurring renewal affordability theme.

title: Call-Centre Renewal Theme Summary - December 2025
content:
## Call-centre themes

Synthetic aggregate transcript themes only.
Most conversations concern renewal documentation and claims status.
Price discussion is not concentrated in a particular portfolio segment.

title: Cancellation Reason Themes - November 2025
content:
## Cancellation reasons

Synthetic and anonymised aggregate summary.
Price is the most frequently recorded renewal cancellation theme, appearing repeatedly rather than as isolated feedback.
The pattern warrants retention and price-elasticity investigation.

title: Renewal Affordability Feedback - December 2025
content:
## Affordability feedback

Synthetic and anonymised aggregate feedback shows price-related concerns across consecutive renewal cycles.
The evidence supports a cautious retention response, not an assumption that a further increase will be absorbed.

title: Call-Centre Renewal Theme Summary - Retention Watch
content:
